evidence.detail: Single template contains Queue/classify, Move/Rename, Search by Card, Search for Conflicts, All Archetypes, and Add Archetype sections — all served from one route
Single route /admin/archetypes/ drives EditArchetypes view handling all the above sections
bakert comment: 'I'd suggest this gets rolled into the bigger task of creating a rules system for archetype classification' — scope is larger than just a UI split

triage.notes: Splitting into three sub-pages (Classify Decks, Edit Tree, Search for Conflicts) would require ~3 new routes in admin.py, ~3 new view classes, and 3 split template files. Likely 200+ lines. bakert explicitly suggested folding this into the larger archetype rules system redesign rather than doing it standalone.
